Deep_Set_Gorilla_Eyes.description: Deep-set gorilla eyes, with their piercing gaze and keen perception, are a testament to the primate's survival instincts, enhancing one's awareness and intimidation factor in the wilds of the game world.

Wide_Lemur_Nocturnal_Orbs.description: The Wide Lemur Nocturnal Orbs are a pair of luminous, bioluminescent eyes that glow softly in the darkness, enhancing the wearer's perception and granting them the uncanny ability to see in the deepest night, as if the very darkness itself was their ally.

Keen_Hunter_Macaque_Eyes.description: With eyes that gleam with an otherworldly clarity, these macaque eyes possess an uncanny ability to pierce through the veil of shadows and fog, granting their bearer an unparalleled sense of awareness and agility in the most treacherous environments.

Tarsier_Giant_Bulging_Eyes.description: The Tarsier Giant Bulging Eyes component endows its bearer with a pair of immense, glowing orbs that pierce the darkness, granting unparalleled night vision and the ability to see through even the subtlest veil of invisibility, enhancing perception and vigilance in the shadows.

Mandrill_Bright_Piercing_Gaze.description: The mandrill's vibrant, piercing eyes, a mesmerizing blend of electric blue and piercing yellow, radiate an otherworldly charisma that captivates all who meet its gaze, enhancing both its charm and perception in the dense, mystical forests of the game world.

Chimpanzee_Intelligent_Eyes.description: These intelligent eyes, reminiscent of a primate's, are imbued with an ancient wisdom and heightened perception, granting the bearer a sharp awareness and the ability to detect the subtle weave of magic in the air.

Spectral_Ape_Glowing_Orbs.description: The Spectral Ape Glowing Orbs are eerie, luminous spheres set within the sockets of a spectral primate's face, pulsating with arcane energy that grants heightened wisdom and perception, piercing through the veil of darkness to reveal the unseen.

Zombie_Primate_Milk_Blind_Eyes.description: These hollow sockets, once vibrant with life, now pulse with a dim, malevolent glow, granting the undead primate a peculiar form of tremor sense, while the mere presence of these blind eyes saps the vitality from the beholder, reducing their perception of the world around them.

Gibbon_Sharp_Canopy_Vision.description: Blessed with eyes that pierce through the dense foliage of the ancient canopy, the Gibbon Sharp Canopy Vision grants its bearer heightened perception and agility, allowing them to spot elusive prey and evade danger with uncanny precision.

Orangutan_Contemplative_Eyes.description: Beneath the shadowed canopy of ancient forests, the Orangutan Contemplative Eyes gleam with an otherworldly wisdom, their deep-set orbs granting unparalleled insight and perception, allowing their bearers to see beyond the veil of reality and detect the faintest whispers of magic in the air.
